full_transcript_playback.text: Hey, Magic Mike here from Ride Electric. I can help with workshop updates, ...
[Patient] Thanks for letting me know. Is there anything specific you'd like help with regarding your bike or scooter?
Yes, I wanna have a look at my booking.
[Enthusiastically] I can help with that. Could you please provide your full name or the job card number for the booking?
Bear with me a moment while I check that in the workshop system.
[Patient] No worries at all, Keith. We’ve all been there. Let’s get your booking sorted together—just a quick moment while I check.
Hey Keith, I’m still here. Just waiting for the system to pull up your booking details. Is everything okay on your end?
Hold on. Don't you bother me. Don't you bother me, contact again. What I would... What I would do is...
